## How to use this workbook {.unnumbered}

Chapters 1-5 (the mechanism-focused chapters) follow a common teaching
pattern: learning objectives, why the topic matters, a mental model, a
visual overview, the technical core (equations with every symbol
defined), a fully worked numeric example, a comparison table,
comprehension questions, a common misconception, an applied exercise,
an interview-style question, a chapter recap, and sources. Chapters 6-8
(case studies, systems synthesis, and emerging directions) adapt this
same pattern deliberately -- for example, replacing a single worked
numeric example with a case-study table or a design exercise where that
fits the material better -- rather than repeating every section
verbatim. Short questions appear near the concept they test, with space
left for written answers if you're using this as a workbook rather than
only a reading; full solutions are collected in the [Answer
Key](#sec-solutions-ch1) for each chapter rather than revealed inline,
so you can attempt each question before checking it. The [Notation
quick reference](#sec-notation) covers every symbol Chapters 1-8 use.
